Part engineer, part community builder.

I'm Simarpreet, a developer advocate and DevRel lead. For two and a half years I led Developer Relations at Tezos India and evangelised Etherlink, its EVM rollup, across India and Southeast Asia. Most recently I was Partnership & Ecosystem Lead at SOULVERSE, working on a trust layer for identity, credentials, compliance and payments. I'm now open to software developer and DevRel roles.

Outside work I run Web3Panjab, a grassroots community onboarding North India to Web3, and a YouTube series on building with Sui from a Solidity developer's perspective. B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, GTBIT, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (2018–2022).

What I bring to any dev team.

Stack-agnostic skills, proven on real developer programs. The tools change; the job of getting developers from first contact to shipped does not.

  • Developer onboarding: −40% onboarding questions

    Starter kits, CLI walkthroughs and explainer videos cut repeat onboarding questions on Discord by 40%.

  • Technical education: 72 students in a credit course

    Co-created a credit-backed blockchain course with the University of the Philippines, alongside structured workshops and live POC demos.

  • Developer programs: 75% graduation rate

    Designed a two-cohort builder camp; 60+ developers stayed on as long-term contributors.

  • Product feedback loop: +24% wallet activation

    Worked with wallet, explorer and protocol teams to turn developer feedback into SDK fixes, including a 24% activation lift for Naan Wallet.

  • Events & hackathons: 1.5K → 13K+ hackathon participants

    Grew a flagship hackathon nearly 9×, then ran 40+ in-person community events across India on a single day.

  • Content & storytelling: 35+ articles & videos

    Tutorials, talks and explainers on Medium, dev.to and YouTube, written for beginners and experienced developers alike.
